svg.title: Storage after 200 edits
svg.desc: One immediate-edit sequence. Full managed allocation is Cargo 371.1 MiB and frust 225.5 MiB, 39.2 percent smaller. Component values are independently rounded.
svg.metadata: Measured source commit 321931ee0ebeaa02cd3177c18f12e5f002c56d17. Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 255H | Linux 7.0.0-42-generic x86_64 | ext4 | rustc 1.97.1. Full managed allocation after edits; target plus additional unique cache allocation plus managed remainder. Retired paths lie beneath other managed roots. Standalone retired_payload_bytes may overlap target/store allocation through shared inodes or extents, is nonadditive, and is annotated separately rather than stacked. Checked unique device/inode allocated blocks; no confidence intervals or repeated-run distribution implied. Policy: {"enabled": true, "every_seconds": 0, "min_growth_bytes": 0, "keep_other_profile_seconds": 1209600, "uncached_dead_grace_seconds": 86400, "dead_incremental_grace_seconds": 3600, "incremental_idle_seconds": 604800, "max_target_bytes": 8589934592, "current_window_seconds": 3600, "hot_window_seconds": 3600, "hot_categories": ["Dylib", "DepsExecutables", "Examples"], "cache_enabled": true, "compress": true, "pass_budget_ms": 2000, "pass_bytes": 536870912}. [["Cargo", [389169152, 0, 0], "Checked allocated blocks of unique device/inode entries, including directories and symlinks. Detected APFS clone sharing is estimated; unknown sharing is charged fully. All unions use one revalidated inventory. Other managed allocation is total minus selected target/store, including control files, temporary or retired payloads and other central targets. Retired payload is the standalone union of queued children, excluding the queue directory itself; it may share allocation with other roots, so do not add it to the total.", null], ["Auto", [182841344, 50421760, 3198976], "Checked allocated blocks of unique device/inode entries, including directories and symlinks. Detected APFS clone sharing is estimated; unknown sharing is charged fully. All unions use one revalidated inventory. Other managed allocation is total minus selected target/store, including control files, temporary or retired payloads and other central targets. Retired payload is the standalone union of queued children, excluding the queue directory itself; it may share allocation with other roots, so do not add it to the total.", 0]]

Cargo: target 371.1 · cache 0 · other 0. Components rounded independently.
